name: Tattoo Box on St Denis
bio:
"Tattoo Box on St Denis in Montreal is a vibrant sanctuary for ink enthusiasts, offering an eclectic mix of styles from a roster of talented artists. Nestled in the heart of the city at 3914 St Denis, this studio stands out for its unique creative environment and commitment to personalized, artistic expression, with each tattoo crafted to be a masterpiece under your skin."
